description: List CRM customers (companies with a won deal or delivered order), filtered by health/lifetime-value/won-deal count, sorted and paginated. Returns summary rows (companyId, name, health, lifetimeValue, wonDeals, lastActivity, owner) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Use get_customer to fetch one customer's detail by company id.

health.description: Filter by customer health. Omit for any. Allowed: healthy, at_risk, churned.

ltv.description: Filter by lifetime-value bucket. Omit for any. Allowed: lt10k, 10k50k, gt50k.

ownerId.description: Filter to customers owned by this workspace member's user id.

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of customers per page (1-100). Default 25.

q.description: Free-text search over the customer company name. Omit for no text filter.

sortDir.description: Sort direction by lifetime value. Default desc (highest first).

wonDealsMin.description: Only customers with at least this many won deals.

name: list_customers
title: List customers
